posts.text:
People often accuse polls of oversampling Democrats.

It's often BS.

But in the case of the University of Michigan's consumer sentiment index, it's true! And it's a huge problem for interpreting how consumers feel about the economy.
posts.summary: Consumer sentiment index overcounts Democrats, creates measurement problem

posts.text: Basically, what you should hope for is that the 10-15% of persuasive but legitimately crazy people are approximately evenly spread out between political movements. When they concentrate together, it means big trouble for the rest of us.
posts.summary: Mentally unstable people concentrate in political movements, destabilize them
posts.quote: Basically, what you should hope for is that the 10-15% of persuasive but legitimately crazy people are approximately evenly spread out between political movements. When they concentrate together, it means big trouble for the rest of us.

posts.text: Depending on the definition, maybe 3-5% of the US population is smart but seriously mentally unstable.  That group heavily selects into politics, though. So maybe you're getting more like 10-15% among certain political types. That's enough to have a real influence on movements.
